title: Venetian Bronze Freestanding Coat Rack, 60-Inch Solid Brass With Eight Pivoting Pegs, Weighted Base, Allied Brass
description: Freestanding coat rack with eight pivoting pegs, 60 in tall with a 10 in x 10 in footprint, solid brass construction for bathroom organization and storage in Venetian Bronze, which presents deep, warm undertones with subtle golden accents, evoking European craftsmanship and timeless style. Floor-standing, no wall mounting required; traditional style with contemporary design elements for classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures. Weighted base keeps the stand stable to help prevent tipping, and a felt pad helps protect floors from scratches. Holds coats, robes, hats, and accessories in a freestanding format. Assembly required. Weight capacity: 18 lb. Product dimensions (LxHxW): 10 x 60 x 10 in. Includes freestanding coat rack. Lifetime warranty. Allied Brass.
